operations.title: Speculations — One Geometric Microkernel, Many Typed Runtimes
The shared Carrier behaves architecturally like a geometric microkernel with sector-specific typed runtimes
operations.summary: The common geometric carrier may generate or constrain sector-specific coefficient-system and physical-readout pairs; the pair, rather than either component alone, may be the natural runtime unit.

operations.title: Cross-sector kernel-break and runtime-pair separation falsifiers
operations.summary: Falsify the conjecture by finding a sector that requires incompatible carrier operations, or by canonically varying coefficient lens independently of physical readout (or conversely) while preserving the same source data.
